_comment: Cards that exist only for the extra-turn test (tests/unit/turn/test_extra_turn.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_time_warp` is Time Warp. `t_gift_turn` is Perch Protection's gift reward on its own, with one card of draw so the unpromised line still does something. `t_turns_for_all` names every player at once, which is the case 500.7's APNAP sentence is about. `t_turn_skipper` is Trouble in Pairs' first line on its own.

cards.name: Test Time Warp
cards.oracle_text: Take an extra turn after this one.

cards.name: Test Gifted Turn
cards.oracle_text:
Gift an extra turn (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they take an extra turn after this one.)
Draw a card.

cards.name: Test Turns For All
cards.oracle_text: Each player takes an extra turn after this one.

cards.name: Test Turn Skipper
cards.oracle_text: If an opponent would begin an extra turn, that player skips that turn instead.

abilities.text: If an opponent would begin an extra turn, that player skips that turn instead.
